entries.name: Schoolboy (blazer uniform)
entries.style: low-poly, flat colours, chibi big-head proportions (Quaternius 2019); recoloured as a dark school blazer uniform

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Wave-1 P1 #88 (gap-schoolboy) had no source; PLAN.md suggests outfitting/recolouring an existing character. This is a recolour of the man-suit entry: the same Suit_Male from the Quaternius Ultimate Animated Character Pack (Nov 2019, CC0, OpenGameArt), same fetch, member and pins; only roles, colours, name, tags and height differ. Suit_Male was picked over man-casual, worker and Kenney mini-male-a/b/c because its materials already separate jacket+trousers (Black), shirt, tie+buckle (Details), belt, hair, skin and eyes, so a blazer + white shirt + tie + dark trousers uniform comes from role mapping alone (the minis bake one texture into T-shirt colours with no collar or tie; the casual and worker outfits have no jacket). Jacket and trousers share one material, so a gakuran's gold buttons or grey trousers are not possible without editing the mesh. Height 1.68 m for a teenager; the big head is the artist's chibi proportion.
